skill.displayName: AI Restaurant and Food Brand Marketing Engine
skill.summary: Scrapes restaurant reviews, competitor data, and trending food content to generate tailored marketing strategies and viral video scripts for food brands.

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Restaurant and Food Brand Marketing Engine v1.0.0

- Initial release providing data-driven marketing tools for restaurants and food brands.
- Scrapes Google Maps, Yelp, TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit for reviews and trending food content.
- Extracts competitor menu, pricing, and ratings data.
- Generates a 30-day social media content calendar with AI-produced video scripts.
- Creates reputation management responses and local SEO strategy suggestions.
- Includes setup documentation and demo code examples for review analysis and competitor research.
